title: The North Face Transgrancanaria 2027 — official schedule
publisher: The North Face Transgrancanaria / Arista Eventos S.L.
claims: The published schedule is headed 2027 and runs from Monday 22 February to Sunday 28 February 2027.
Open Agáldar starts on Tuesday 23 February at 09:00 in San José de Caideros, Gáldar, and its awards ceremony is at 13:00 in Plaza de Santiago, Gáldar.
KV El Gigante starts on Wednesday 24 February at 15:00 in Valle de Agaete.
The Half starts on Thursday 25 February at 09:00 in Santa Lucía de Tirajana with three wave starts; the Promo starts the same day at 10:30 in Artenara.
The Marathon starts on Friday 26 February at 09:30 in Tejeda; the Classic starts that day at 23:59 at Saulo Torón Square, Las Canteras Beach, Las Palmas de Gran Canaria.
The Advanced starts on Saturday 27 February at 09:00 in Teror, and the Short and Family Trail start at 10:00 in Teror.

The Classic and Advanced finish line closes on Sunday 28 February at 06:00 at Parque Sur, Maspalomas; life bags are returned at Expomeloneras between 09:00 and 14:00 and the awards ceremony is at 12:00.

Bib collection opens on Monday 22 February from 16:00 to 19:00 for KV, Half, Open Agáldar, Stages and Promo only; from Tuesday 23 to Thursday 25 February it runs 10:00–14:00 and 16:00–19:00, and on Friday 26 February 10:00–14:00 and 16:00–18:00.
